root: ^My brother is coming to steal this land from you.
^He knows it has the best fish, and he wishes it all for himself.
^This is the last thing I need! UGH!

Fish: ^Is this really the most important thing right now?
^Yes, we are both talking fish-people. Get used to it.
^There are bigger things for you to be worried about right now.
Family: ^Then you must be prepared to defend it.
Ugh: ^Ugh, indeed. My brother is also quite hideous.
Fin: ^My brother will arrive in three days time and challenge you to a duel.
^Sharpen your skills, fisherman. Do not let him win.
